key_points: Q3 adjusted EPS growth of 10.3% and gross margin expansion support the earnings beat narrative.
Mako orthopaedics, Endoscopy, and Medical contributed solidly, though hip/knee procedure softness and supply pressures remain headwinds.
CEO comments reinforce US-based robotic knee production and a $400M soft-tissue surgical robot bet, supporting the long-term robotics thesis.
Analyst tone is moderately bullish, but the stock has trailed the broader market and several headlines are recaps/valuation commentary rather than new catalysts.
Overall news flow is modestly positive but not thesis-changing; most near-term items are already reflected or low incremental impact.
